overall: The draft is checker-clean (393/393) and most single-token items are solid, but there are four recurring problems. (1) Concept leakage: items on Cupid's mythology (Psyche, Venus), Eros (the ' erotic' etymology item), Februus/februa (Lupercalia origin lore), and translation items for ' namorados' and ' 情人' (the words that name the holiday in Brazil and China) favour a fan. Reclassify ' namorados' as exclusive and probably ' Febru' too. (2) Forced wording for the no-space/capitalized variants: quoted mid-sentence capitals ("Affection", "Coup", "Cup", "February", "Christmas Island", "Lo mein", "Flower arranging", Wars of the "Roses"), parentheticals like "(lovers in ...)" and "(Valentinian I)", and lowercase 'romance languages' or 'Queen of hearts'. Starting the sentence with the word yields the no-space token for Affection, Coup, Christmas, February, Flower and Lo, so use that. (3) Giveaways and duplicates: answers echoed in the question (Gregorian/Gregory, Julian/Julius, Turkish/Turkey, Flower of Scotland, Cookie Monster, Stay Puft Marshmallow Man, marsh/Marshes, Rosa, Viola, Florida/flor), plus repeats across tokens (radiocarbon x2, Pasadena x3, Henry VIII x3, hippies x3, Lancelot, Pyramus, Darcy, 'lover of wisdom', candy/sweets, Valentin vs ' Valentin' near-copies). (4) Obscure trivia beyond a 2B model, mostly in the hard tokens (' Valent', ' Valentín', 'Valentin', ' violets', ' Hug', ' Cupid' moon, 'jura' maxim, sherry flor, Gypsophila). For those, accept fewer than 4 items with a note rather than padding. Also: 'ladin' has 3 items without a note, and the World Cup 'most titles' item is not stable.
